# Synthetic prose corpus v2: prospective length goals

This new input version preserves the six invented scenarios, all semantic goals,
section/fact rosters and 43 available negative seeds from v1. Its manifest declares
six document types, two audiences and three repeats (36 cells). These are planned
inputs, not provider results or evaluated negatives. V1 and its failed study stay
unchanged. No captured v1 output counts as a v2 generation or independent repeat.

Five document types have advisory ranges. The technical-design case retains a
required 1200..1600 range to exercise the long-document path. Independent semantic
review still decides fidelity, coverage, purpose, unsupported claims and status.
Length warnings cannot establish semantic quality or authorize publication.

The separately reviewed [goal scope](../document-scopes/v2-length-goals.json) fixes
all six goal rosters and length definitions, plus the mandatory long witness.
The CLI requires its explicit raw hash on both prepare and capture. This caller pin
binds reviewed bytes; it is not an authenticated organizational policy signature.
Changing the scope requires owner review and a new frozen study, never a replay
under an old identity. The runner must not choose or silently refresh this pin.

Frozen input identities:

- Corpus SHA-256: `da99d1c025764c445967dd8d71c56e63992108feaa682d1ba81685155c0688bd`
- Goal scope SHA-256: `41988f2f526415763d64faa7193e477f1370c56bfd2a0e269427dbbf0c004403`
- Count rule: `markdown-whitespace-fields/v1`. Count whitespace fields in the full
  canonical Markdown, including headings and citation syntax; this is not a
  universal linguistic word count.

This is an offline policy qualification fixture. No paid v2 cohort is frozen or
executed by adding it. A later study must bind its own lanes, budget and complete
acceptance protocol to these inputs before dispatch, retaining failed and missing
cells and the original stage spend. HP-A14 and HP-A18 remain open.
